queries.text: Why did the United States move to force TikTok's sale or ban it between 2024 and 2025, and how was the dispute resolved?
Number of US federal laws enacted in 2024 and 2025 mandating the divestiture or ban of TikTok
Percentage share of US social media users aged 13-17 who reported using TikTok daily in 2023 and 2024
Count of US government agencies that banned TikTok from official devices between January 2022 and December 2024
Name of the primary national security threat assessment document issued by the US Department of Defense regarding ByteDance data practices in 2019, 2021, and 2023
Date of the Supreme Court oral arguments scheduled for *TikTok v. Garland* in November 2024

Outcome classification (upheld or struck down) of the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals ruling on the constitutionality of the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act in August 2024
Number of days given to TikTok to divest its operations in the United States under the final agreement signed between the Trump administration and ByteDance in January 2025
Percentage ownership stake allocated to US investors in the proposed joint venture structure announced by Oracle and Silver Lake for TikTok's US entity in December 2023

search_hits.title: The US TikTok divest-or-ban saga (2024-2025)
search_hits.snippet: The US moved to force TikTok's sale or ban it between 2024 and 2025; an Oracle-led joint-venture deal resolved it.
